args.query:
-- Compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel
-- For each signup cohort (signup_date), find users who were active in 90-day window after signup
WITH signups AS (
  SELECT user_id, channel AS acquisition_channel, DATE(trunc(signup_date,'day')) AS signup_date
  FROM users
  WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-07-12'
),
activities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, DATE(activity_date) AS activity_date
  FROM activity
  WHERE activity_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-07-12'
)
SELECT s.acquisition_channel,
       count(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS cohort_size,
       count(DISTINCT case when a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND a.activity_date <= s.signup_date + 90 THEN s.user_id end) AS retained_90
FROM signups s
LEFT JOIN activities a
  ON a.user_id = s.user_id
  AND a.activity_date > s.signup_date
  AND a.activity_date <= s.signup_date + 90
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY retained_90 DESC;

SELECT s.acquisition_channel,
       count(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS cohort_size,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.customer_id END) AS retained_90,
       round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.customer_id END) / nullif(count(DISTINCT s.customer_id),0),2) AS retained_90_pct
FROM signups s
LEFT JOIN activities a
  ON a.customer_id = s.customer_id
  AND a.active_date > s.signup_date
  AND a.active_date <= s.signup_date + 90
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY retained_90_pct DESC;
